literal_meaning: কাঁচা (অপরিশোধিত বা কাঁচা) কাঁচা মণি (রত্ন) রমণি (সুন্দর রত্ন)
figurative_meaning_en: Things remain as they are; everyone stays in their inherent state
similar_in_english: A leopard can't change its spots
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কখনো বদলাবে না, কাঁচা কাঁচা মণিরমণি।
গ্রামের লোকেরা এমনই, কাঁচা কাঁচা মণিরমণি থেকে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He will never change; raw gems remain raw.
The villagers are like that; things stay as they are.
note: This idiom draws from the imagery of unpolished gems in natural settings, emphasizing inherent qualities.
